title: orbea lepida
intro: Orbea lepida, commonly known as the "Burning Star", is a succulent plant that belongs to the Apocynaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Orbea lepida include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which can help to reduce pain, fever, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
